contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate of Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: [---]DIVS AVG. Reverse description: Female figure standing left with cornucopiae on left arm and right arm extended to rudder, probably Fortuna. Reverse inscription: [FORTVNA AVG].
